required.quote: A certificate of registration as a home inspector may not be renewed unless the home inspector has complied with the continuing competency requirements established by the department.

hours_per_period.quote: The department shall require at least eight hours of continuing competency activity for each licensing period.

available.quote: A board established under this title and the department, with respect to an occupation that it regulates under this title, may by regulation establish criteria for issuing a temporary courtesy license to nonresidents who enter the state so that, on a temporary basis, they may practice the occupation regulated by the board or the department.

requirements.value: Temporary courtesy licenses may be issued to nonresidents; military members and spouses with substantially equivalent credentials from another state may obtain temporary courtesy licenses valid for 180 days (extendable once).
requirements.quote: the department or appropriate board shall issue a temporary courtesy license to an active duty member of the armed forces of the United States or the spouse of an active duty member of the armed forces of the United States if the active duty member or spouse meets the requirements of this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: The application for endorsement or registration is fraudulent or misleading.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the application is fraudulent or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: The endorsement holder or registrant has knowingly violated this chapter or a lawful order or regulation of the department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the endorsement holder or registrant has knowingly violated this chapter or a lawful order or regulation of the department

disciplinary_grounds.description: The endorsement holder or registrant is incompetent or has engaged in fraudulent practices.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the endorsement holder or registrant is incompetent or has engaged in fraudulent practices

disciplinary_grounds.description: The required insurance ceases to be in effect, resulting in automatic suspension.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the insurance required in AS 08.18.101 ceases to be in effect, the registration of the contractor or home inspector shall be suspended until the insurance has been reinstated.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A final judgment impairs the surety bond or depletes the cash deposit below the required amount.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a final judgment impairs the liability of the surety upon the bond or depletes the cash deposit so that there is not in effect a bond undertaking or cash deposit in the full amount prescribed in AS 08.18.071, the registration of the contractor or home inspector involved shall be suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: The bonding company cancels the contractor's or home inspector's bond.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a bonding company cancels its bond of a contractor or home inspector, the contractor's or home inspector's registration shall be revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A registered contractor or home inspector fails to fulfill obligations as set out in AS 08.18.071.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a registered contractor or registered home inspector fails to fulfill the contractor's or home inspector's obligations as set out in AS 08.18.071, the contractor's or home inspector's registration shall be suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of an offense related to forgery, theft, extortion, defrauding creditors, or a felony involving dishonesty within the preceding seven years.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: within the seven years preceding the date of application, has not been under a sentence for an offense related to forgery, theft in the first or second degree, extortion, or defrauding creditors or for a felony involving dishonesty

disciplinary_grounds.description: The applicant has had authority to perform home inspections revoked in this state or another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has not had the authority to perform home inspections revoked in this state or in another jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: The applicant is subject to an unresolved criminal complaint or disciplinary action related to real estate or home inspection matters.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is not the subject of an unresolved criminal complaint or unresolved disciplinary action before a regulatory authority in this state or in another jurisdiction related to real estate or home inspection matters

bonding_required.quote: each applicant shall, at the time of applying for a certificate of registration, file with the commissioner a surety bond running to the state

insurance_required.quote: Each applicant, at the time of applying for registration or upon renewal of registration, shall file with the commissioner satisfactory evidence that the applicant has in effect ... public liability and property damage insurance covering the applicant's contracting operations in this state
